caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular scene with a diagonally striped border of red and black. Inside the frame, on the left, there is a small island with a palm tree and a yellow sign labeled “CUBA.” To the right of the palm tree, a Cuban flag with blue and white stripes and a red triangle is flying. In the center, there is a large, white ship with two red funnels and several yellow, black, and blue details, shown travelling on blue water. The ship has numerous ropes and flags, including a visible American flag at the rear and a red and blue flag at the front. On the right side of the image, there is a cluster of large, red flowers with green stems and leaves, emerging from brown soil. The background of the scene is a light pink color. Below the illustrated area, the name "Carl Keksi" is printed on the plain beige background.
title: Hooked Rug
